pattern: ^\[Win32App\] Get 0 apps for user session (?<sessionId>\d+), user id = (?<userId>[a-f0-9\-]+)
description: Detects when IME enumerated a user session and found zero targeted Win32 apps. IME then skips its 'Completed user session' line entirely (the zero-app branch in ApplicationPoller continues before that log statement), so this line is the only evidence that user-phase enforcement finished on a device with no user-targeted apps. Treated as equivalent to a completed user session.
